custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 3.4 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The column header row still shows.
  • Centred under it: a magnifier icon inside a light grey circle, and under that dark text reading No parts match the search "XQXQXQ".
  • No rows are listed.

Step 2:

  • The Inactive tab shows the same magnifier, light grey circle and "No parts match the search" line, not "No inactive parts at this location."

Step 3:

  • The search text is cleared and the Inactive tab lists its parts, or "No inactive parts at this location." if the location has none.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List)

  • S1-N2: “If a search or filter leaves the Inactive tab empty, it shows the list's standard filtered empty state.”
  • S1-N1: “If there are no inactive parts at the location and no search or filter is narrowing the list, the Inactive tab shows "No inactive parts at this location."”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
